command_line:
set -eu
cat > analysis.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
input_path <- args[[1]]
result_path <- args[[2]]
summary_path <- args[[3]]

message("R version: ", R.version.string)
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(limma))
message("limma version: ", as.character(packageVersion("limma")))

df <- read.table(input_path, header=TRUE, sep="\t", quote="", comment.char="", check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
if (ncol(df) < 3) stop("Expected miRNA identifier plus sample columns")
mirna <- df[[1]]
sample_names <- names(df)[-1]
patient_idx <- grep("^P_", sample_names)
control_idx <- grep("^C_", sample_names)
if (length(patient_idx) < 2 || length(control_idx) < 2) stop("Expected at least two patient and two control columns")
mat <- as.matrix(df[, -1, drop=FALSE])
storage.mode(mat) <- "numeric"

pvals <- apply(mat, 1, function(row) {
  patient <- as.numeric(row[patient_idx])
  control <- as.numeric(row[control_idx])
  t.test(patient, control, alternative="two.sided", var.equal=FALSE)$p.value
})
bonf <- p.adjust(pvals, method="bonferroni")
by <- p.adjust(pvals, method="BY")
sig_bonf <- sum(!is.na(bonf) & bonf <= 0.05)
sig_by <- sum(!is.na(by) & by <= 0.05)
ratio <- paste0(sig_bonf, ":", sig_by)

all_results <- data.frame(miRNA=mirna, p_value=pvals, Bonferroni=bonf, Benjamini_Yekutieli=by, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
write.table(all_results, file=result_path, sep="\t", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE)
summary <- data.frame(method=c("Bonferroni", "Benjamini-Yekutieli", "ratio"), value=c(as.character(sig_bonf), as.character(sig_by), ratio), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
write.table(summary, file=summary_path, sep="\t", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE, col.names=FALSE)
RSCRIPT
